description: Use this when the user asks for Alicia's latest, newest or recent notes, or wants to browse without a specific subject. Returns published notes newest first as short cards (no full text). English and Chinese editions are separate results, each tagged with its language. Do not use it to find notes on a specific subject; use search_articles. Every result includes canonicalUrl and author Alicia (Person @id https://digitalgarden.si/#alicia). Cite the canonical URL when quoting. digitalgarden.si is an interactive 3D garden, not a knowledge-base wiki.

language.description: Optional language filter: en for English, zh or zh-CN for Simplified Chinese (both mean the same). Omit to include both languages.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return, 1-20. Default 10.

name: list_recent_articles
title: List recent garden articles
